children: Signet just reported "another sparkle qtr," as Jefferies analysts call it. "Sales came in line, EPS beat, but the quality of the quarter is what stands out," the analysts say, pointing to comparable sales growth across each of the company's fine jewelry brands and cost discipline efforts that are driving bottom line improvement ahead of plan. They also highlight the company's confident setup into the holiday season. "Execution is compounding rather than one-off," they say. Signet rallies 10% premarket.(kelly.cloonan@wsj.com)
